propositions: Contributors and agents must fast-forward their own worktree (not the shared main checkout) after a Gerrit merge and before closing a ticket to ensure the merged commit is reachable from HEAD for the close precheck.

The completion verifier (_referencing_commit_exists) reads git log from repo_root with ref=HEAD and requires the rebar-ticket: commit to be reachable; fast-forwarding the shared checkout clobbers uncommitted operator WIP and violates separation of concerns.
AGENTS.md must document post-merge fast-forward discipline with explicit warnings against touching the shared main checkout.
CONTRIBUTING.md must add a new §2f subsection after §2e (Submit) that prescribes the post-merge worktree fast-forward workflow before ticket closure.
Documentation-only fix: no code changes to src/rebar; the underlying close mechanism is correct; only human/agent guidance was missing.
